title: 1-D Factor Graph: virtual clone, deep copy, factory
hints: Each concrete factor implements `clone()` as `return std::make_unique<PriorFactor>(*this);`: the derived class knows its own type, the graph doesn't.
Copy constructor: reserve, then `for (const auto& f : other.factors_) factors_.push_back(f->clone());`.
Copy assignment: copy-and-swap. `FactorGraph tmp(other); std::swap(factors_, tmp.factors_); return *this;` is exception-safe and handles self-assignment.
parseFactor: read with std::istringstream; after reading the expected fields, `std::string extra; if (iss >> extra) return nullptr;`. Also reject sigma <= 0 and negative keys.
